title: Event body: <package>.diagnostic.recorded
description: The detail of a failed command that its error message does not carry: the lower-layer error chain, outermost first, or a panic's stack and the Go type of its value. The one body schema shared by the kind every package writes as its own, <package>.diagnostic.recorded. It holds no value and never the text of a request, an argument or an option. The event's basis is the observation of the request that failed (schema hive.request, the request_id), or, when the request could not be read, of the invocation (schema hive.invocation, the event's own correlation_id). See spec/events.md.

operation.description: The operation invoked. Absent when the failure came before one was named.

status.description: The status of the response that was written.

code.description: The code of the response's error.

request_id.description: The failed request's request_id. Absent when the request could not be read.

detail.description: The lower-layer error chain, outermost first. Each string is clipped to 1,024 bytes.

stack.description: The stack of a panic, clipped to 8,192 bytes. Present only for a panic.

panic_type.description: The Go type of a panic's value, never the value. Present only for a panic.
